description.en: High-crafted React effect libraries tailored for AI agents, featuring Border Beam, Thinking Orbs, Gooey, Liquid Metal, and Image Loaders.
description.zh: 专为 AI 与智能体界面打造的高质感 React 特效组件库：包含流光边框、思维光球、流体黏连、液态金属与图像生成加载器。

content.en: Libraries.dev is a curated suite of production-ready React effect libraries purpose-built for modern AI agent products and craft-focused web applications. Developed by Jakub Antalík, the toolkit provides five standalone, high-performance visual effects: Border Beam (an animated rainbow glow following arbitrary element borders), Thinking Orbs (2D canvas particle thought-state indicators), Gooey (liquid morphing and merging UI pieces), Liquid Metal (real-time reflective chrome rings for buttons and icons), and Image Generation (WebGL card generation loaders). Each effect ships as an independent npm package with TypeScript definitions and zero unnecessary dependencies.
content.zh: Libraries.dev 是一套专为新一代 AI 智能体应用与高审美前端界面打造的 React 特效组件套件，由设计师兼工程师 Jakub Antalík 独立打磨。全套工具箱涵盖五个独立开箱的高质感视觉特效：Border Beam（自适应任意边框的彩虹流光外框）、Thinking Orbs（纯 2D Canvas 打造的 9 种智能体思维波纹与状态球）、Gooey（液体般融合与分离的黏连流体交互）、Liquid Metal（实时反射环境光的液态金属材质环）以及 Image Generation（用于生图卡片的 WebGL 渐进加载态）。各个效果均支持独立 npm 包按需安装，配齐完整 TypeScript 类型。
